about: Append-only decision log. Never rewrite an entry; supersede with a new one that names the old id.

decisions.title: Adopt the AIStart repo-starter-solo memory pattern for this fork
decisions.decision: Agent memory is the five-file tracking set (GOAL.json, WORK_MAP.json, DECISIONS.json, ARTIFACTS.json, WORK_LEDGER.md) under .agents/, plus check_tracking.py. Handoff information flows through WORK_MAP node 'next' fields (in-flight) and WORK_LEDGER lines (finished): a cold session resumes from those two files alone.
decisions.why: Matches the locked AIStart fleet-adoption design (hub docs/proposals/2026-08-04, amendment 2026-08-05); plain files, harness-neutral, append-mostly.

decisions.title: Branch discipline: meta on fork main, PR branches from upstream/main
decisions.decision: Fork main = upstream main + meta commits (AGENTS.md, .agents/). Every upstream-bound branch starts from upstream/main so PRs never contain meta files. Main syncs by rebasing meta commits onto upstream/main.
decisions.why: Upstream is a one-way GitLab->GitHub mirror; the maintainer cherry-lands PR commits. Clean single-topic PRs are the only ones that can land.

decisions.title: Commit identity: ragesaq with DCO sign-off
decisions.decision: All commits in this fork are ragesaq <11304287+ragesaq@users.noreply.github.com>, set repo-locally. Upstream-bound commits add Signed-off-by via git commit -s. No Caliper/PsiClawOps identity in this repo.
decisions.why: Public personal-account contribution; upstream CONTRIBUTING.md requires DCO. Mirrors the openclaw/* personal-identity carve-out in the operator's global policy.

decisions.title: BLE lands as a transport-only addition behind INiimbotTransport
decisions.decision: The Bluetooth work implements INiimbotTransport (build spec section 5.1) and touches nothing in framing, commands, or client layers. The .NET BLE stack choice is open (tracked as ragesaq-003) and gets its own decision entry before coding.
decisions.why: This is exactly how upstream issue #13 scopes the work; maximizes the chance the PR lands as-is.
